title: Predictive Text Autocomplete Index
description: Implement a dictionary data structure that supports inserting new words and checking if a word or a specific prefix exists in the dictionary. You need to implement a prefix tree (Trie) class with insert, search, and startsWith methods.
constraints: word and prefix consist only of lowercase English letters.
At most 3 * 10^4 calls in total will be made to insert, search, and startsWith.
input_format: A sequence of method calls with their respective string arguments.
output_format: Boolean values for search and startsWith operations.

examples.output: [null, null, true, false, true, null, true]
examples.explanation: Inserting 'apple' allows searching for 'apple' (true), 'app' (false for exact match, but true for startsWith), and after inserting 'app', searching for 'app' becomes true.
Searching for a word longer than any inserted prefix returns false.
Searching for a prefix in an empty trie returns false.
